"Escritura
ENCARGO MAESTRO PARA AI GAME MAKER
LA ESPADA CELESTIAL: RPG RETRO
Videojuego RPG de acción, aventura, fantasía y criaturas coleccionables
INSTRUCCIÓN PRINCIPAL
Quiero que desarrolles un videojuego completo llamado LA ESPADA CELESTIAL: RPG RETRO.
Quiero que actúes como un estudio profesional de videojuegos. Debes encargarte de la programación, diseño visual, animaciones, escenarios, personajes, controles, interfaces, sonido, historia, enemigos, criaturas, sistemas de progresión y pruebas.
No quiero una demo que solamente parezca un videojuego. Quiero que cada sistema esté implementado y conectado.
Adapta el proyecto a las capacidades reales de AI Game Maker. Si una función no está disponible, indícalo claramente y no simules que funciona.
1. ESTILO GRÁFICO
Crear un RPG de fantasía medieval con:
Perspectiva 2D cenital.
Estética anime HD cinematográfica.
Personajes detallados y expresivos.
Escenarios espectaculares.
Animaciones fluidas.
Iluminación y sombras dinámicas cuando sea posible.
Efectos mágicos y partículas.
Diseños originales.
Interfaz moderna y profesional.
Quiero una calidad visual muy superior a un RPG retro básico. Mantener la esencia de aventura de las consolas portátiles, pero con presentación moderna.
2. PLATAFORMAS
Prioridad: Android en horizontal.
Preparar también soporte para:
Pantallas táctiles.
Mandos Bluetooth.
PC, si la herramienta permite exportarlo.
Optimizar rendimiento, resolución, interfaz y controles para cada plataforma compatible.
3. MANDOS Y CONTROLES
Diseñar un sistema de control completo:
Cruceta: movimiento.
A: ataque principal.
B: esquivar o acción secundaria.
X: habilidad especial.
Y: interactuar.
L: cambiar arma o habilidad.
R: cambiar criatura o habilidad.
Start: pausa y menú.
Select: acceso rápido.
Controles táctiles:
Cruceta virtual.
Botones de acción.
Tamaño y posición configurables.
Respuesta inmediata.
Diseño cómodo para jugar en horizontal.
Los controles deben estar conectados a las acciones reales del protagonista.
4. JUGABILIDAD
Implementar:
Movimiento en ocho direcciones.
Colisiones.
Cámara que siga al personaje.
Ataques y combos.
Esquivas.
Bloqueos.
Magia.
Habilidades especiales.
Exploración.
Secretos.
Interacción con objetos.
Enemigos inteligentes.
Jefes con distintas fases.
Recompensas y progresión.
Cada acción debe tener respuesta visual y sonora.
5. PERSONAJE PRINCIPAL
Crear un protagonista personalizable con:
Nombre.
Apariencia.
Peinado.
Ropa.
Armas.
Armaduras.
Accesorios.
Estadísticas:
Vida.
Maná.
Resistencia.
Fuerza.
Defensa.
Velocidad.
Inteligencia.
Suerte.
Incluir experiencia, niveles, atributos y habilidades desbloqueables.
El equipamiento debe reflejarse visualmente en el personaje cuando sea técnicamente posible.
6. ARMAS Y COMBATE
Incluir:
Espadas.
Mandobles.
Dagas.
Lanzas.
Arcos.
Bastones.
Escudos.
Magia elemental.
Cada arma tendrá estadísticas, alcance, velocidad, daño y animaciones propias.
Enemigos iniciales:
Gelatina silvestre.
Lobo de ceniza.
Escarabajo pétreo.
Espectro de las ruinas.
Guardián corrompido.
Los enemigos deben detectar al protagonista, perseguirlo, atacar y reaccionar al daño.
7. CRIATURAS COLECCIONABLES
Crear criaturas con afinidades:
Fuego.
Agua.
Tierra.
Viento.
Rayo.
Hielo.
Luz.
Oscuridad.
Naturaleza.
Energía Celestial.
Permitir:
Encuentros.
Captura.
Colección.
Entrenamiento.
Alimentación.
Evolución.
Subida de nivel.
Equipamiento.
Combate.
Las criaturas tendrán habilidades y diseños originales.
También ayudarán en la exploración:
Iluminar.
Detectar secretos.
Quemar obstáculos.
Congelar mecanismos.
Mover objetos.
Activar interruptores.
Nadar.
Volar.
Servir de monturas.
8. MENÚS
Crear menús completos, visualmente atractivos y funcionales:
Menú principal.
Nueva partida.
Continuar.
Selección de personaje.
Inventario.
Equipo.
Habilidades.
Mapa.
Misiones.
Criaturas.
Colección.
Fabricación.
Tiendas.
Estadísticas.
Ajustes.
Guardar y cargar.
Incluir animaciones, transiciones, iconos y sonidos de navegación.
No crear botones decorativos sin func (Phone/Tablet, touch controls, optional accelerometer tilt; request motion permission on iOS)
"

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.

- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.

- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, fully functional browser game “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL: RPG RETRO”: 2D top-down action RPG with action combat, collectible creatures, progression, menus, shops, crafting, save/load, touch + gamepad + keyboard controls, original procedural art/audio, optimized for Android landscape.

## Requirements
- User wants a complete game, not a demo; every system connected and functional, no decorative buttons.
- Spanish UI/story.
- Visual style: top-down 2D, anime HD cinematic feel, detailed expressive characters, spectacular scenery, fluid animation, dynamic lighting/shadows where possible, magic/particles, original designs, modern professional UI.
- Platforms: Android landscape priority, touch, Bluetooth gamepad, PC if possible; optimize per platform.
- Controls: D-pad movement; A attack, B dodge/secondary, X special, Y interact, L weapon/skill switch, R creature switch, Start pause/menu, Select quick access; touch joystick, action buttons, configurable size/position, landscape-comfortable.
- Gameplay: 8-direction movement, collisions, follow camera, attacks/combos, dodge, block, magic, skills, exploration, secrets, object interaction, intelligent enemies, multi-phase bosses, rewards/progression, visual+audio feedback for every action.
- Character customization: name, appearance, hair, clothes, weapons, armor, accessories; stats HP/MP/stamina/STR/DEF/SPD/INT/LUCK; XP, levels, attributes, unlockable skills; equipment reflected visually when possible.
- Weapons: swords, greatswords, daggers, spears, bows, staves, shields; each with stats/range/speed/damage/animations. Initial enemies: Gelatina Silvestre, Lobo de Ceniza, Escarabajo Pétreo, Espectro de las Ruinas, Guardián Corrompido; enemies detect, chase, attack, react.
- Creatures: 10 elements (Fuego, Agua, Tierra, Viento, Rayo, Hielo, Luz, Oscuridad, Naturaleza, Energía Celestial); encounters, capture, collection, training, feeding, evolution, leveling, equipment, combat; exploration abilities: light, detect secrets, burn obstacles, freeze mechanisms, move objects, activate switches, swim, fly, mounts.
- Menus: main, new game, continue, character select, inventory, equipment, skills, map, quests, creatures, collection, crafting, shops, stats, settings, save/load; animated transitions/icons/navigation sounds; no fake buttons.
- If AI Game Maker lacks a feature, state it clearly and don’t simulate functionality.
- Final parenthetical: touch controls, optional accelerometer tilt; request motion permission on iOS.

## Decisions
- Build as static HTML5 Canvas 2D + WebAudio + DOM UI, served by existing OMGithub static server; no external assets/frameworks.
- Original procedural vector art and synthesized music/SFX instead of licensed/AI images.
- 5 zones: Aldea de Lumen, Bosque de los Susurros, Ruinas de Aethel, Cañón de Ceniza, Templo Celestial.
- 10 creature species: Ignis, Aqua, Terron, Zephyra, Volt, Glacius, Lumina, Umbra, Sylva, Aether.
- Real-time combat and capture (weaken wild creature, then seal), creature auto-assist, exploration ability gating.
- Save system: 3 manual slots + autosave in localStorage; shrine autosaves.
- Responsive portrait support retained (no forced rotate overlay) so mobile capture looks good; landscape recommended.
- Keyboard mapping: J/Z/Space attack, K/Shift dodge/block, L skill, E interact, Q weapon, R creature, Esc menu, Tab quick.
- Touch controls hidden unless coarse pointer or enabled in settings; settings can force on/off.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored workspace/runtime; confirmed static HTML deployment and Playwright capture flow.
- Created `index.html` with canvas, boot screen, HUD, touch controls, UI/modal roots.
- Created `css/style.css` (~900 lines) covering title, HUD, menus, creation, pause tabs, shop, dialogue, modals, touch, responsive.
- Created `js/icons.js` original SVG icon set.
- Created `js/data.js` full item/weapon/armor/accessory/creature/enemy/skill/recipe/quest/zone data.
- Created `js/audio.js` procedural WebAudio music per zone/battle/boss and SFX.
- Created `js/input.js` keyboard, gamepad, touch joystick/buttons, rumble.
- Created `js/render.js` procedural humanoid, weapons, slash, creatures, enemies, portraits, color helpers.
- Created `js/world.js` 5 generated tile maps, collision, obstacles, NPCs/chests/shrines/relics/runes/gates/altars, ground baking, lighting sources, weather, interaction, minimap support hooks.
- Created `js/entities.js` Player, Enemy AI (blob/wolf/beetle/wraith/guardian/boss phases), WildCreature, Projectile, Hazard, Particle, DamageNumber.
- Created `js/ui.js` HUD, title, creation, pause tabs, inventory/equipment/skills/map/quests/creatures/collection/crafting/stats/save/settings, shop, dialogue typewriter/choices, modals, quick panel, toasts, game over/victory/credits.
- No commit made; all new files untracked.

### Active
- Need to create `js/game.js` (core state, loop, rendering, combat orchestration, quests, zone transitions, save/load, shop/crafting/creature methods, settings, title scene, minimap/equipment/creation previews).
- Need to create `js/main.js` bootstrap.
- Need to add small CSS rules for HUD/dialogue canvas sizing.
- Need to run server + Playwright, catch console errors, test title/creation/gameplay/menus/mobile, fix bugs.

### Blocked
- Game cannot run yet because `game.js`/`main.js` are missing.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js` with all methods referenced by `ui.js`, `entities.js`, `world.js`:
   - `state`, `derived`, `getWeapon/getShield/getAbilities/getActiveCreature`, `skillDef`
   - `newGame`, `continueGame`, `loadGame`, `saveGame`, `getSlots`, `getAutosave`, `hasAnySave`, `resetAll`, `openLoadScreen`, `toTitle`, `confirmTitle`, `respawn`, `victoryContinue`
   - `setMode`, `openPause`, `closePause`, `togglePause`, `toggleQuick`, `closeQuick`, `uiBlocking`, `openShop`, `closeShop`
   - `update`, `render`, `resize`, `boot`, title scene, camera/lighting/weather, render sorted world+entities
   - `performPlayerAttack`, `spawnSlash`, `castSkill`, `creatureAssist`, `spawnPlayerProjectile`, `spawnEnemyProjectile`, `addHazard`, `addDamage`, `shake`, `hitstop`, `toast`, `particles`
   - `interact`, NPC dialogue scripts, chests/relics/runes/obstacles/altar/gates, quests (`advanceQuest`, `completeQuest`, `startQuest`, `getMainQuestTracker`, `runeCount`), zone load/transitions/spawns/bosses
   - `onEnemyDeath`, `onWildDefeated`, `onBossDeath`, `attemptCapture`, `playerDown`, `damagePlayer`
   - inventory/equipment/craft/shop/creature methods used by UI: `useItem`, `equipItem`, `unequip`, `unlockSkill`, `setActiveSkill`, `addStat`, `trainCreature`, `feedCreature`, `evolveCreature`, `equipCharm`, `unequipCharm`, `craft`, `canCraft`, `buyItem`, `sellItem`, `creatureDisplayName`, `setActiveCreature`, `cycleWeapon`, `cycleCreature`
   - settings methods `loadSettings`, `saveSettings`, `setSetting`, `toggleFullscreen`, `isCoarse`, `syncTouch`
   - previews `drawCreationPreview`, `drawEquipmentPreview`, `drawMiniMap`
   - `this.renderRef = { drawHumanoid, drawEnemy, resolveAppearance }`
2. Implement `js/main.js`: instantiate `Game`, expose `window.game`, call `game.boot()`.
3. Fix known bugs:
   - `render.js` `drawHeldWeapon` lacks `hammer` case (Torin currently draws sword).
   - `entities.js` beetle `state === 'attack'` branch only lunges for wolf; add beetle lunge/damage.
   - `entities.js` `drawPlayerVisual` passes item wrapper instead of `weaponDef.weapon` into `drawHumanoid`.
   - `world.js` `applyFlags` runeDisplay active logic is convoluted; ensure `relic:relic_runa_bosque` etc. flags set.
   - `ui.js` `showSettingsTitle` and settings refresh flow should be validated.
   - Ensure `UI` import of unused `creature`, `xpForLevel` harmless.
4. Start server with `RUNTIME_DIR=$RUNTIME_DIR PORT=3002 ./start.sh` in tmux/persistent session.
5. Use Playwright to screenshot title, create character, start game, open each pause tab, shop, dialogue, mobile viewport; check console/page errors; fix.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: missing core orchestration; must implement all game/UI APIs.
- `js/ui.js`: all UI screens and expected game method names; primary contract.
- `js/entities.js`: player/enemy/creature/projectile behavior; known small bugs.
- `js/world.js`: maps, collision, interactables, rendering, lights; map data and flags.
- `js/data.js`: item/creature/enemy/skill/recipe/quest/zone definitions.
- `js/render.js`: procedural art; fix hammer and player weapon argument.
- `js/input.js`: keyboard/gamepad/touch API (`axis`, `pressed`, `down`, `lastInputType`, `rumble`).
- `js/audio.js`: `audio.init/playMusic/sfx/setVolumes`.
- `css/style.css`: all classes used by UI; add canvas sizing for `.char-portrait canvas`, `.dialogue-portrait canvas`.
- `index.html`: DOM IDs expected by UI/game.
- `README.md`: update with game description/controls/platform notes.
- `start.sh`: server entry; uses `RUNTIME_DIR`.
- `capture.sh`: screenshot entry; `CAPTURE_URL`/`CAPTURE_DIR`.

## Important Context
- Environment: Node v24, static server auto-detects `index.html`; `start.sh` uses `RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime` and `PORT=3002` for dev.
- `playwright-cli` installed; README says use headed Chromium/SwiftShader and `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002`.
- Capture auto-start only clicks a button whose text exactly matches `/^(?:start|play)(?:\s+(?:game|now))?$/i`; title buttons are Spanish, so capture will show title screen.
- `UI.syncChrome()` calls `initHUD()` repeatedly; ensure idempotent.
- `UI.updateHUD()` assumes `game.derived`, `game.player`, `game.boss`, `game.settings`, `game.getMainQuestTracker()`, `game.creatureDisplayName()`.
- `UI.showDialogue()` sets mode `'dialogue'`; `closeDialogue(true)` runs `onEnd` without resetting mode; `onEnd` must set playing or open shop.
- `World.load()` expects `game.state.flags` and `game.player`; spawns entities must be handled by game.
- `Player` starts at hardcoded `19.5*T, 16.5*T`; game must override on zone load.
- `Enemy`/`WildCreature` constructor coordinates are tile units; multiply by `T`.
- `Player.render()` uses `game.renderRef`; must be assigned before first render.
- `drawPlayerVisual` currently passes wrong weapon object shape; fix before testing visuals.
- `UI.showPause` re-renders whole screen on selection; acceptable, but sliders update without rerender.
- Touch controls are `#touchControls`; UI toggles hidden based on settings/coarse pointer and mode.
- `settings` keys: `master`, `music`, `sfx`, `touch` (`auto|on|off`), `touchScale` (`normal|compact`), `shake`, `damage`, `hints`.
- Save keys not yet implemented; suggested `la_espada_celestial_saves_v1`, `la_espada_celestial_autosave_v1`, `la_espada_celestial_settings_v1`.
- All files currently uncommitted/untracked; no tests run yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, fully functional browser game “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL: RPG RETRO”: 2D top-down action RPG with action combat, collectible creatures, progression, menus, shops, crafting, save/load, touch + gamepad + keyboard controls, original procedural art/audio, optimized for Android landscape.

## Requirements
- User wants a complete game, not a demo; every system connected and functional, no decorative buttons.
- Spanish UI/story.
- Visual style: top-down 2D, anime HD cinematic feel, detailed expressive characters, spectacular scenery, fluid animation, dynamic lighting/shadows where possible, magic/particles, original designs, modern professional UI.
- Platforms: Android landscape priority, touch, Bluetooth gamepad, PC if possible; optimize per platform.
- Controls: D-pad movement; A attack, B dodge/secondary, X special, Y interact, L weapon/skill switch, R creature switch, Start pause/menu, Select quick access; touch joystick, action buttons, configurable size/position, landscape-comfortable.
- Gameplay: 8-direction movement, collisions, follow camera, attacks/combos, dodge, block, magic, skills, exploration, secrets, object interaction, intelligent enemies, multi-phase bosses, rewards/progression, visual+audio feedback for every action.
- Character customization: name, appearance, hair, clothes, weapons, armor, accessories; stats HP/MP/stamina/STR/DEF/SPD/INT/LUCK; XP, levels, attributes, unlockable skills; equipment reflected visually when possible.
- Weapons: swords, greatswords, daggers, spears, bows, staves, shields; each with stats/range/speed/damage/animations. Initial enemies: Gelatina Silvestre, Lobo de Ceniza, Escarabajo Pétreo, Espectro de las Ruinas, Guardián Corrompido; enemies detect, chase, attack, react.
- Creatures: 10 elements (Fuego, Agua, Tierra, Viento, Rayo, Hielo, Luz, Oscuridad, Naturaleza, Energía Celestial); encounters, capture, collection, training, feeding, evolution, leveling, equipment, combat; exploration abilities: light, detect secrets, burn obstacles, freeze mechanisms, move objects, activate switches, swim, fly, mounts.
- Menus: main, new game, continue, character select, inventory, equipment, skills, map, quests, creatures, collection, crafting, shops, stats, settings, save/load; animated transitions/icons/navigation sounds; no fake buttons.
- If AI Game Maker lacks a feature, state it clearly and don’t simulate functionality.
- Final parenthetical: touch controls, optional accelerometer tilt; request motion permission on iOS.

## Decisions
- Build as static HTML5 Canvas 2D + WebAudio + DOM UI, served by existing OMGithub static server; no external assets/frameworks.
- Original procedural vector art and synthesized music/SFX instead of licensed/AI images.
- 5 zones: Aldea de Lumen, Bosque de los Susurros, Ruinas de Aethel, Cañón de Ceniza, Templo Celestial.
- 10 creature species: Ignis, Aqua, Terron, Zephyra, Volt, Glacius, Lumina, Umbra, Sylva, Aether.
- Real-time combat and capture (weaken wild creature, then seal), creature auto-assist, exploration ability gating.
- Save system: 3 manual slots + autosave in localStorage; shrine autosaves.
- Responsive portrait support retained (no forced rotate overlay) so mobile capture looks good; landscape recommended.
- Keyboard mapping: J/Z/Space attack, K/Shift dodge/block, L skill, E interact, Q weapon, R creature, Esc menu, Tab quick.
- Touch controls hidden unless coarse pointer or enabled in settings; settings can force on/off.
- Added planned settings keys beyond prior checkpoint: `touchHand` (`right|left`), `tilt` boolean; add UI/CSS for left-handed touch layout and optional tilt with iOS `DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission`.
- Aether acquisition planned at Temple altar after 3 runes; altar sets `temple_ready`, opens gate, spawns final boss.
- Terron planned as passive mount (+22% movement speed) to satisfy mounts requirement.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored workspace/runtime; confirmed static HTML deployment and Playwright capture flow.
- Created `index.html` with canvas, boot screen, HUD, touch controls, UI/modal roots.
- Created `css/style.css` (~700 lines) covering title, HUD, menus, creation, pause tabs, shop, dialogue, modals, touch, responsive.
- Created `js/icons.js` original SVG icon set.
- Created `js/data.js` full item/weapon/armor/accessory/creature/enemy/skill/recipe/quest/zone data.
- Created `js/audio.js` procedural WebAudio music per zone/battle/boss and SFX.
- Created `js/input.js` keyboard, gamepad, touch joystick/buttons, rumble.
- Created `js/render.js` procedural humanoid, weapons, slash, creatures, enemies, portraits, color helpers.
- Created `js/world.js` 5 generated tile maps, collision, obstacles, NPCs/chests/shrines/relics/runes/gates/altars, ground baking, lighting sources, weather, interaction, minimap support hooks.
- Created `js/entities.js` Player, Enemy AI (blob/wolf/beetle/wraith/guardian/boss phases), WildCreature, Projectile, Hazard, Particle, DamageNumber.
- Created `js/ui.js` HUD, title, creation, pause tabs, inventory/equipment/skills/map/quests/creatures/collection/crafting/stats/save/settings, shop, dialogue typewriter/choices, modals, quick panel, toasts, game over/victory/credits.
- Read and analyzed all existing files to derive exact contracts for missing `game.js`.
- No commit made; all new files untracked.

### Active
- Need to create `js/game.js` (core state, loop, rendering, combat orchestration, quests, zone transitions, save/load, shop/crafting/creature methods, settings, title scene, minimap/equipment/creation previews).
- Need to create `js/main.js` bootstrap.
- Need to apply planned patches to existing files (details in Next Move).
- Need to run server + Playwright, catch console errors, test title/creation/gameplay/menus/mobile, fix bugs.

### Blocked
- Game cannot run yet because `game.js`/`main.js` are missing.

## Next Move
1. Implement `js/game.js` with all methods referenced by `ui.js`, `entities.js`, `world.js`:
   - `state`, `derived`, `getWeapon/getShield/getAbilities/getActiveCreature`, `skillDef`
   - `newGame`, `continueGame`, `loadGame`, `saveGame`, `saveAuto`, `getSlots`, `getAutosave`, `hasAnySave`, `latestSaveKey`, `resetAll`, `openLoadScreen`, `toTitle`, `confirmTitle`, `respawn`, `victoryContinue`
   - `setMode`, `openPause`, `closePause`, `togglePause`, `toggleQuick`, `closeQuick`, `uiBlocking`, `openShop`, `closeShop`
   - `update`, `render`, `resize`, `boot`, title scene, camera/lighting/weather, render sorted world+entities
   - `performPlayerAttack`, `spawnSlash`, `spawnPlayerProjectile`, `castSkill`, `creatureAssist`, `spawnEnemyProjectile`, `addHazard`, `addDamage`, `shake`, `hitstop`, `toast`, `particles`, `findNearestEnemy`
   - `interact`, NPC dialogue scripts for Elara/Mira/Torin/Lía/Nilo/Roderic, chests/relics/runes/obstacles/altar/gates, quests (`advanceQuest`, `completeQuest`, `startQuest`, `setQuestStage`, `getMainQuestTracker`, `runeCount`, `grantItem`)
   - zone load/transitions/spawns/bosses, `spawnBoss`, `bossCondition`
   - `onEnemyDeath`, `onWildDefeated`, `onBossDeath`, `attemptCapture`, `playerDown`, `damagePlayer`
   - inventory/equipment/craft/shop/creature methods: `useItem`, `equipItem`, `unequip`, `unlockSkill`, `setActiveSkill`, `addStat`, `addXp`, `gainCreatureXp`, `trainCreature`, `feedCreature`, `evolveCreature`, `equipCharm`, `unequipCharm`, `craft`, `canCraft`, `buyItem`, `sellItem`, `creatureDisplayName`, `setActiveCreature`, `cycleWeapon`, `cycleCreature`
   - settings methods `loadSettings`, `saveSettings`, `setSetting`, `toggleFullscreen`, `enableTilt`, `applyTilt`, `isCoarse`, `syncTouch`
   - previews `drawCreationPreview`, `drawEquipmentPreview`, `drawMiniMap`
   - `this.renderRef = { drawHumanoid, drawEnemy, resolveAppearance, drawCreature }`
2. Implement `js/main.js`: instantiate `Game`, expose `window.game`, call `game.boot()`.
3. Apply known fixes:
   - `render.js` `drawHeldWeapon` lacks `hammer` case (Torin draws sword).
   - `entities.js` beetle `state === 'attack'` branch only lunges for wolf; add beetle lunge/damage.
   - `entities.js` `drawPlayerVisual` passes item wrapper instead of `weaponDef.weapon` into `drawHumanoid`.
   - `entities.js` footstep plays `audio.sfx('ui')` every 0.32s; remove/replace.
   - `entities.js` after `g.interact()` add early return if `g.mode !== 'playing'` to avoid same-frame actions.
   - `entities.js` Terron mount speed multiplier.
   - `world.js` add `b.rect(41, 0, 2, 1, 'p')` in `buildBosque` so north exit is reachable (currently y=0 solid `t`).
   - `world.js` `applyFlags` runeDisplay active logic is convoluted; ensure `rune_taken:*` / `relic:*` flags set.
   - `ui.js` `initHUD` must reset `this.portraitFor = null` or HUD portrait stays blank after re-init.
   - `ui.js` `refreshSettings` must branch on `game.mode === 'paused'` rather than stale `currentTab`.
   - `ui.js` `closeDialogue` set `game.inputGuardUntil = performance.now() + 180` to prevent same-frame re-interact/re-open.
   - `ui.js` add global navigation `audio.sfx('ui')` in `_onClick`.
   - `ui.js` settings add `tilt` toggle, `touchHand` cycle action (`cycle-touch-hand`), and creature UI mount tag.
   - `css/style.css` add `.touch-controls.lefty` swaps joystick/actions/top; add `.char-portrait canvas { width:100%; height:100%; display:block; }`.
4. Start server with `RUNTIME_DIR=$RUNTIME_DIR PORT=3002 ./start.sh` in tmux/persistent session.
5. Use Playwright to screenshot title, create character, start game, open each pause tab, shop, dialogue, mobile viewport; check console/page errors; fix.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: missing core orchestration; must implement all game/UI APIs.
- `js/ui.js`: all UI screens and expected game method names; primary contract.
- `js/entities.js`: player/enemy/creature behavior; known small bugs.
- `js/world.js`: maps, collision, interactables, rendering, lights; map data and flags.
- `js/data.js`: item/creature/enemy/skill/recipe/quest/zone definitions.
- `js/render.js`: procedural art; fix hammer and player weapon argument.
- `js/input.js`: keyboard/gamepad/touch API (`axis`, `pressed`, `down`, `lastInputType`, `rumble`).
- `js/audio.js`: `audio.init/playMusic/sfx/setVolumes`.
- `css/style.css`: all classes used by UI; add canvas sizing and left-handed touch CSS.
- `index.html`: DOM IDs expected by UI/game.
- `README.md`: update with game description/controls/platform notes.
- `start.sh`: server entry; uses `RUNTIME_DIR`.
- `capture.sh`: screenshot entry; `CAPTURE_URL`/`CAPTURE_DIR`.

## Important Context
- Environment: Node v24, static server auto-detects `index.html`; `start.sh` uses `RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime` and `PORT=3002` for dev.
- `playwright-cli` installed; README says use headed Chromium/SwiftShader and `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002`.
- Capture auto-start only clicks a button whose text exactly matches `/^(?:start|play)(?:\s+(?:game|now))?$/i`; title buttons are Spanish, so capture will show title screen.
- `UI.syncChrome()` calls `initHUD()` repeatedly; ensure idempotent and reset portrait cache.
- `UI.updateHUD()` assumes `game.derived`, `game.player`, `game.boss`, `game.settings`, `game.getMainQuestTracker()`, `game.creatureDisplayName()`.
- `UI.showDialogue()` sets mode `'dialogue'`; `closeDialogue(true)` runs `onEnd` without resetting mode; `onEnd` must set playing or open shop.
- `World.load()` expects `game.state.flags` and `game.player`; spawns entities must be handled by game.
- `Player` starts at hardcoded `19.5*T, 16.5*T`; game must override on zone load.
- `Enemy`/`WildCreature` constructor coordinates are tile units; multiply by `T`.
- `Player.render()` uses `game.renderRef`; must be assigned before first render.
- `drawPlayerVisual` currently passes wrong weapon object shape; fix before testing visuals.
- `UI.showPause` re-renders whole screen on selection; acceptable, but sliders update without rerender.
- Touch controls are `#touchControls`; UI toggles hidden based on settings/coarse pointer and mode.
- Settings keys: `master`, `music`, `sfx`, `touch` (`auto|on|off`), `touchScale` (`normal|compact`), `touchHand` (`right|left`), `tilt`, `shake`, `damage`, `hints`.
- Save keys planned: `la_espada_celestial_saves_v1`, `la_espada_celestial_autosave_v1`, `la_espada_celestial_settings_v1`.
- All files currently uncommitted/untracked; no tests run yet.
- Previous attempted `write` of `js/game.js` failed due to output token limit; split file creation into smaller writes/edits.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, fully functional browser game “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL: RPG RETRO”: 2D top-down action RPG with action combat, collectible creatures, progression, menus, shops, crafting, save/load, touch + gamepad + keyboard controls, original procedural art/audio, optimized for Android landscape.

## Requirements
- User wants a complete game, not a demo; every system connected and functional, no decorative buttons.
- Spanish UI/story.
- Visual style: top-down 2D, anime HD cinematic feel, detailed expressive characters, spectacular scenery, fluid animation, dynamic lighting/shadows where possible, magic/particles, original designs, modern professional UI.
- Platforms: Android landscape priority, touch, Bluetooth gamepad, PC if possible; optimize per platform.
- Controls: D-pad movement; A attack, B dodge/secondary, X special, Y interact, L weapon/skill switch, R creature switch, Start pause/menu, Select quick access; touch joystick, action buttons, configurable size/position, landscape-comfortable.
- Gameplay: 8-direction movement, collisions, follow camera, attacks/combos, dodge, block, magic, skills, exploration, secrets, object interaction, intelligent enemies, multi-phase bosses, rewards/progression, visual+audio feedback for every action.
- Character customization: name, appearance, hair, clothes, weapons, armor, accessories; stats HP/MP/stamina/STR/DEF/SPD/INT/LUCK; XP, levels, attributes, unlockable skills; equipment reflected visually when possible.
- Weapons: swords, greatswords, daggers, spears, bows, staves, shields; each with stats/range/speed/damage/animations. Initial enemies: Gelatina Silvestre, Lobo de Ceniza, Escarabajo Pétreo, Espectro de las Ruinas, Guardián Corrompido; enemies detect, chase, attack, react.
- Creatures: 10 elements (Fuego, Agua, Tierra, Viento, Rayo, Hielo, Luz, Oscuridad, Naturaleza, Energía Celestial); encounters, capture, collection, training, feeding, evolution, leveling, equipment, combat; exploration abilities: light, detect secrets, burn obstacles, freeze mechanisms, move objects, activate switches, swim, fly, mounts.
- Menus: main, new game, continue, character select, inventory, equipment, skills, map, quests, creatures, collection, crafting, shops, stats, settings, save/load; animated transitions/icons/navigation sounds; no fake buttons.
- If AI Game Maker lacks a feature, state it clearly and don’t simulate functionality.
- Final parenthetical: touch controls, optional accelerometer tilt; request motion permission on iOS.

## Decisions
- Build as static HTML5 Canvas 2D + WebAudio + DOM UI, served by existing OMGithub static server; no external assets/frameworks.
- Original procedural vector art and synthesized music/SFX instead of licensed/AI images.
- 5 zones: Aldea de Lumen, Bosque de los Susurros, Ruinas de Aethel, Cañón de Ceniza, Templo Celestial.
- 10 creature species: Ignis, Aqua, Terron, Zephyra, Volt, Glacius, Lumina, Umbra, Sylva, Aether.
- Real-time combat and capture (weaken wild creature to ≤40% HP, then seal); creature auto-assist; exploration ability gating.
- Save system: 3 manual slots + autosave in localStorage; shrine autosaves.
- Responsive portrait support retained (no forced rotate overlay) so mobile capture looks good; landscape recommended.
- Keyboard mapping: J/Z/Space attack, K/Shift dodge/block, L skill, E interact, Q weapon, R creature, Esc menu, Tab quick.
- Touch controls hidden unless coarse pointer or enabled in settings; settings can force on/off.
- Aether acquisition: Temple altar after 3 runes sets `temple_ready`, opens gate, grants Aether, spawns final boss.
- Terron is passive mount (+22% movement speed) to satisfy mounts requirement.
- Guardian boss filtered key drops; Runa de Aethel comes from the relic unlocked by boss death, avoiding duplicate key items.
- Final boss grants/equips `espada_celestial` and triggers victory screen.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored workspace/runtime; confirmed static HTML deployment and Playwright capture flow.
- Created `index.html`, `css/style.css` (~700 lines), `js/icons.js`, `js/data.js`, `js/audio.js`, `js/input.js`, `js/render.js`, `js/world.js`, `js/entities.js`, `js/ui.js`.

"Escritura
ENCARGO MAESTRO PARA AI GAME MAKER
LA ESPADA CELESTIAL: RPG RETRO
Videojuego RPG de acción, aventura, fantasía y criaturas coleccionables
INSTRUCCIÓN PRINCIPAL
Quiero que desarrolles un videojuego completo llamado LA ESPADA CELESTIAL: RPG RETRO.
Quiero que actúes como un estudio profesional de videojuegos. Debes encargarte de la programación, diseño visual, animaciones, escenarios, personajes, controles, interfaces, sonido, historia, enemigos, criaturas, sistemas de progresión y pruebas.
No quiero una demo que solamente parezca un videojuego. Quiero que cada sistema esté implementado y conectado.
Adapta el proyecto a las capacidades reales de AI Game Maker. Si una función no está disponible, indícalo claramente y no simules que funciona.
1. ESTILO GRÁFICO
Crear un RPG de fantasía medieval con:
Perspectiva 2D cenital.
Estética anime HD cinematográfica.
Personajes detallados y expresivos.
Escenarios espectaculares.
Animaciones fluidas.
Iluminación y sombras dinámicas cuando sea posible.
Efectos mágicos y partículas.
Diseños originales.
Interfaz moderna y profesional.
Quiero una calidad visual muy superior a un RPG retro básico. Mantener la esencia de aventura de las consolas portátiles, pero con presentación moderna.
2. PLATAFORMAS
Prioridad: Android en horizontal.
Preparar también soporte para:
Pantallas táctiles.
Mandos Bluetooth.
PC, si la herramienta permite exportarlo.
Optimizar rendimiento, resolución, interfaz y controles para cada plataforma compatible.
3. MANDOS Y CONTROLES
Diseñar un sistema de control completo:
Cruceta: movimiento.
A: ataque principal.
B: esquivar o acción secundaria.
X: habilidad especial.
Y: interactuar.
L: cambiar arma o habilidad.
R: cambiar criatura o habilidad.
Start: pausa y menú.
Select: acceso rápido.
Controles táctiles:
Cruceta virtual.
Botones de acción.
Tamaño y posición configurables.
Respuesta inmediata.
Diseño cómodo para jugar en horizontal.
Los controles deben estar conectados a las acciones reales del protagonista.
4. JUGABILIDAD
Implementar:
Movimiento en ocho direcciones.
Colisiones.
Cámara que siga al personaje.
Ataques y combos.
Esquivas.
Bloqueos.
Magia.
Habilidades especiales.
Exploración.
Secretos.
Interacción con objetos.
Enemigos inteligentes.
Jefes con distintas fases.
Recompensas y progresión.
Cada acción debe tener respuesta visual y sonora.
5. PERSONAJE PRINCIPAL
Crear un protagonista personalizable con:
Nombre.
Apariencia.
Peinado.
Ropa.
Armas.
Armaduras.
Accesorios.
Estadísticas:
Vida.
Maná.
Resistencia.
Fuerza.
Defensa.
Velocidad.
Inteligencia.
Suerte.
Incluir experiencia, niveles, atributos y habilidades desbloqueables.
El equipamiento debe reflejarse visualmente en el personaje cuando sea técnicamente posible.
6. ARMAS Y COMBATE
Incluir:
Espadas.
Mandobles.
Dagas.
Lanzas.
Arcos.
Bastones.
Escudos.
Magia elemental.
Cada arma tendrá estadísticas, alcance, velocidad, daño y animaciones propias.
Enemigos iniciales:
Gelatina silvestre.
Lobo de ceniza.
Escarabajo pétreo.
Espectro de las ruinas.
Guardián corrompido.
Los enemigos deben detectar al protagonista, perseguirlo, atacar y reaccionar al daño.
7. CRIATURAS COLECCIONABLES
Crear criaturas con afinidades:
Fuego.
Agua.
Tierra.
Viento.
Rayo.
Hielo.
Luz.
Oscuridad.
Naturaleza.
Energía Celestial.
Permitir:
Encuentros.
Captura.
Colección.
Entrenamiento.
Alimentación.
Evolución.
Subida de nivel.
Equipamiento.
Combate.
Las criaturas tendrán habilidades y diseños originales.
También ayudarán en la exploración:
Iluminar.
Detectar secretos.
Quemar obstáculos.
Congelar mecanismos.
Mover objetos.
Activar interruptores.
Nadar.
Volar.
Servir de monturas.
8. MENÚS
Crear menús completos, visualmente atractivos y funcionales:
Menú principal.
Nueva partida.
Continuar.
Selección de personaje.
Inventario.
Equipo.
Habilidades.
Mapa.
Misiones.
Criaturas.
Colección.
Fabricación.
Tiendas.
Estadísticas.
Ajustes.
Guardar y cargar.
Incluir animaciones, transiciones, iconos y sonidos de navegación.
No crear botones decorativos sin func (Phone/Tablet, touch controls, optional accelerometer tilt; request motion permission on iOS)
"
